tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search Codemate's website: service pages, client case studies and articles. Returns the best-matching titles with their URLs and a one-line summary. Use this to find out what Codemate does, which industries and technologies it has delivered in, or whether it has written about a topic.

tools.name: list_references
tools.description: List Codemate's client case studies (called references on the site), with the client name, industries, services, a summary and the URL. Filter by industry, service or client. Use this when asked what Codemate has delivered, for whom, or for proof of experience in a sector — search_site only returns

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List Codemate's published articles, newest first, with date, category, summary and URL. Filter by category or by date. Use this when asked what Codemate has written or published about something, or for recent news — search_site only returns the closest few matches.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Read the full text of one of Codemate's main pages. Valid ids: what-we-do, design, code, care, how-we-deliver, ai-transformation, solutions, paimen-ai, about, google-partnership. Returns the page summary, its sections and any FAQ. Use this to answer questions about Codemate's services, delivery mode

tools.name: list_open_positions
tools.description: List the jobs Codemate is currently hiring for, with location, the job page URL and the application link. Use this when asked whether Codemate is hiring, or about careers and open roles.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get authoritative facts about Codemate as a company: what it does, its legal entities, and whatever else it publishes about itself. Use this when asked to describe or introduce Codemate, rather than assembling an answer from service pages and articles. Only states facts Codemate has verified — if so

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get how to reach Codemate: office addresses with map links, named people with their role, email, phone, LinkedIn and photo, plus the general sales email and phone numbers. Filter by role or office. Use this when asked how to contact Codemate, who to speak to about something, or where its offices are

tools.name: get_page_data
tools.description: Read the full text of a codemate.com article or client case study, given the URL that search_site, list_articles or list_references returned. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, list_references, list_articles, list_open_positions, get_contact_info, get_page_data · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_contact_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, list_references, list_articles, list_open_positions, get_contact_info, get_page_data · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_contact_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
